column1: # Key of the code of Commissary Adolf Ebers (Eberschildt), Moscow 1662-1666 (lead 2315; Riksarkivet, Diplomatica Muscovitica
# SE/RA/2113/2113.1/3/b/602, series R0003225), rebuilt by Brice Dudout (Claude Opus 5.5 agents), 10 Nov 2026.
# Licence: CC BY 4.0, Brice Dudout (the key table as rebuilt here; the glosses it comes from are the decipherment of the time).
# German letter substitution with homophones, 2-digit groups 15-95, groups separated by dots, mixed with clear German;
# Arabic numerals (3, 12, 2000, 2500) are written in clear.
# Learned from the contemporary glosses of images 106 and 108 only (53 glossed words, frozen/PAIRES-EBERS.tsv), frozen
# (SHA-256 15a63f9b...1c18), then measured once on image 138 (validation.txt): 0.909 of characters vs 0.047 for the best of
# 200 shuffled keys. Rows marked "post" were added AFTER the measurement and are outside the test.
